role: EVALUATOR ONLY — never append to model inputs
reference_policy: Historical document constraints, not provider-confirmed optimal ownership or true-violation labels; current placement is not oracle.

claims.claim: DT backend owns property decoding and node status; no kernel registration/mapping/allocation policy.
claims.condition: Node-local interpretation; distinguish population or ancestor policy.
claims.description: is_available reads own status; absence/ok/okay accepted.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Conditional consistency of this behavior with stated DT capability boundary; not proof of device readiness or architectural optimality.

claims.claim: Neutral resource facts separate interpretation from acquisition; backend parses and validates.
claims.condition: Mapping/acquisition must not be inferred from resource-return types.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Supports adapter/delegation characterization; delegated address algorithm and runtime behavior are not closed by packet.

claims.claim: Backend-neutral contract with no parser/kernel policy; prose says util while tree says drivers/firmware/fwnode.
claims.condition: Semantic contract and physical directory claim must be separated.
claims.description: Opaque IDs, borrowed backend and handle operations.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Can characterize type/trait seam; conflicting physical-location prose cannot uniquely establish intended directory or justify mandatory move.

claims.claim: Host integration retains boot DTB ownership/initialization until migrated; other boot helpers separately tracked.
claims.condition: Transitional exception; ownership prose is not proof of allocation ownership.
claims.description: Lazy global initialization calls LinuxFdt::from_ptr and registers root; caller supplies lifetime obligation.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Retaining host integration can be consistent under stated exception; no proof host frees or owns backing allocation.

claims.claim: Controller register roles/interrupt encodings belong to drivers; ACPI/static producers are planned peers; multi-region programming excluded.
claims.condition: Parsing controller config is distinct from backend generic DT translation and hardware programming.
claims.description: Discovers node, interprets controller regions, produces GicConfig/GicSelection.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Controller-specific producer can remain in driver under this document. Actual hardware initialization/validation not included as complete implementation.

claims.claim: Migration document reports IRQ lookup Unsupported; contract distinguishes specifier cells from controller meaning.
claims.condition: First part is historical capability/status report, not timeless prohibition.
claims.description: irq_spec delegates query and returns target plus cells.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Can identify document/implementation status conflict; not genuine responsibility violation or unique new migration prescription.

historical_test_counts.allowed: attribute as statements, not this run's execution evidence

exposure: All six units and historical analyses already seen by development team. Not independent holdout.
